settings.title: Settings
settings.ai_mode_on_device_desc: Mail content never leaves your device
settings.ai_mode_cloud_desc: More accurate long summaries · requires your consent
settings.ai_mode_note: When cloud AI is on, only anonymized excerpts are sent, and every send is logged.
settings.cloud_consent_title: Allow sending data to cloud AI?
settings.cloud_consent_body: When enabled, anonymized excerpts (emails and phone numbers removed) may be sent to a third-party AI service for more accurate summaries. Your mailbox never leaves this device otherwise. Every send is recorded in the Transparency log. You can turn this off again at any time.
settings.transparency_log_empty: No data has ever been sent to the cloud
settings.remove_account_body: "{}" and all of its synced mail will be removed from this device. Mail on the server is not affected.
settings.auto_clean_otp_desc: Runs on every app launch, only removes OTPs that have already expired
